snippet.title: NEVER A PENALTY - Official Trailer | You send the proof
snippet.description:
NEVER A PENALTY: pixel-art football referee simulator. Review the VAR, send the proof. Out now on PC.

🎮 Get it now:
Microsoft Store (Windows, 7.99 EUR): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nj0516716fd

You don't blow the whistle. You send the proof. From the review room you check cameras, a magnifier and offside lines, and you uphold or switch every call while a phone buzzes with envelopes.
• Eight endings, from the Copa Orbe to prison
• Cameras, magnifier and offside lines to decide each play
• Dark sports satire in pixel art
